Erin: Quick favor — trying to reproduce a perf regression for small-model v3 on RTX hosts. Can someone run a lightweight nsys + torchprof capture on rtx-dedicated and upload the artifacts? Need: 8 warmup inferences, then 2 measured steps, batch=4, seq=1024. Please wrap warmup in an NVTX range named 'kv_warmup' so we can isolate KV cache effects. @Matt @Sasha

Matt: I can pick this up in ~30m. Which nsys flags + torchprof config do you want?

Erin: Thanks — minimal capture to keep file size down. Use this for nsys (adjust output path):
```
nsys profile \
  --trace=nvtx,cuda,osrt \
  -o /tmp/trace_2212345678 \
  --sample=none \
  --stats=true \
  --force-overwrite \
  --capture-range=nvtx \
  --capture-range-begin=warmup \
  --capture-range-end=measure \
  --disable-cupti-api=true \
  --capture-start-cpu=true \
  python -m run_infer --model small-v3 --batch 4 --seq 1024 --warmup 8 --steps 2
```
And run torch.profiler in onnx/torchprof lite mode to emit the chrome trace and a .pt or json summary. Example snippet:
```python
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA], on_trace_ready=torch.profiler.tensorboard_trace_handler(out_dir)) as p:
    for i in range(warmup+steps):
        with torch.autograd.profiler.record_function('infer_step'):
            model(input)
```
Upload everything to s3://redwood-perf/traces/2212345678/<yourname>/ and post link here.

Sasha: Quick Q — do we need token redaction for these traces? Also which commit/tag should I compare to?

Erin: Good call. Use the scrub_tokens helper before upload: `tools/trace_tools/scrub_tokens.py --input <nsys.qdrep> --output <clean.qdrep>` (it strips hostnames + input tensors). Commit: tag `release/v3.2` — that's the baseline we saw the regression on. Also please attach the raw torchprof json so I can generate flamegraphs.

PerfBot: Reminder: uploads to s3://redwood-perf/traces will be auto-expired after 30 days unless you set a retention label. See #eng-runtime docs. :robot_face:

Matt: Running now on rtx-006. I added NVTX ranges: "warmup" and "measure" and a "kv_warmup" zone inside warmup. Will scrub and upload when done.

Matt: Uploaded:
- s3://redwood-perf/traces/2212345678/matt-rtx006/trace_2212345678.qdrep
- s3://redwood-perf/traces/2212345678/matt-rtx006/torchprof.json
- s3://redwood-perf/traces/2212345678/matt-rtx006/flamegraph.svg

Erin: Perfect — thanks. Can you also paste the `nsys stats` summary (text) from the run? That helps me spot cross-kernel stalls quickly.

Matt: Pasted the top-level stats in the uploaded `nsys_stats.txt` file in the same folder. TL;DR: kernel compute % looks normal, but cuda memcpy time up during measure window.

Sasha: I'll pull the files and run the flamegraph diff against release/v3.2. If I see a suspicious memcpy spike I'll grab the offending kernel name and ping infra for driver checks.

Erin: Awesome — after Sasha's pass, we'll decide if we need a bigger profile with full CUPTI sampling. Thanks team :thumbsup:
